clue.text: Dress down for a runner, perhaps

definitions.meaning: to dress someone down is to scold them, as a boss does when calling an employee in for a reprimand
a stair runner is a long strip of floor covering, one example of the category

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: the verb means to reprimand, and a runner is a narrow rug laid along stairs or a hall.

clue.text: Helped a very upwardly mobile cook

indicators.note: in a down clue, moving upwards means the cook's name is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Delia Smith is Britain's best-known TV cookery writer

explanation.surface: An aspiring social climber of a cook who helped out.
explanation.walkthrough: DELIA Smith is a famous British TV cook; read upwards she gives AILED.
explanation.definitionFit: To be of use or benefit to someone is a formal synonym for helped them.

clue.text: Evenly plant fir on terrace

indicators.note: evenly means taking letters at regular intervals, here every other one starting from the first

explanation.surface: A gardener told to plant a fir tree on the terrace in an even way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Evenly' takes alternate letters, here the odd-placed ones of 'plant fir on'.
explanation.definitionFit: A paved outdoor sitting area beside a house is a patio or terrace.

clue.text: Air Force gal lost in pitch battle

indicators.note: in means these letters go inside the pitch word

parts.note: tar is black pitch
RAF is the Royal Air Force

indicators.note: lost suggests the word gal is disoriented, so its letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A female air-force member lost amid a pitched battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pitch battle' suggests 'pitched battle', but pitch is the black substance, not the field or the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1805 naval clash off Cape Trafalgar, Nelson's famous victory, is a well-known battle.

clue.text: Reserve example written works here

parts.note: to reserve a table or seat is to book it
a case is an instance or example of something

explanation.surface: Someone reserving a sample of written works.
explanation.definitionFit: Shelving furniture is where written works, i.e. volumes, are kept: a descriptive definition of the piece of furniture.

clue.text: Sound of explosion outside destroyed red chamber

indicators.note: outside means the explosion word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: a boom is the noise an explosion makes

indicators.note: destroyed means the word red is wrecked and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A blast outside wrecks a red room.
explanation.definitionFit: Chamber is an old word for a private room, especially one for sleeping in.

clue.text: Fiends turn up with only half of spares

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game

indicators.note: only half of takes the back half of the word spares

explanation.surface: Monsters appear holding only half their spare parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogres are cruel man-eating giants of folk tales, so they are wicked fiends.

clue.text: Hit the golf course — wearing these?

parts.note: to cuff is to strike with an open hand
a links is a seaside golf course

explanation.surface: Heading out to hit the golf course, perhaps in smart dress.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative fasteners for shirt sleeves are worn on the cuffs, so these are items one might be wearing.

clue.text: Dodgy South American exercise court

parts.note: US means American, as in US forces
PE is physical education, i.e. exercise

explanation.surface: A shady South American working out at a sports court.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dodgy is questionable or of doubtful honesty, which is what the adjective means.

clue.text: With no end of hope, actress ran daft new movement in design

indicators.note: new tells us these letters are made over into a fresh arrangement
with no signals that a letter is taken away from the word that follows it in the fodder
end of picks out the final letter of the word hope

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Without a happy ending, an actress launched a silly new trend in design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With no end of hope' removes E (the last letter of hope) from ACTRESS, giving ACTRSS; 'new' shuffles ACTRSS + RAN + DAFT.
explanation.definitionFit: The late-Victorian decorative style championed by William Morris was a reform movement in design and handicraft.

clue.text: Artist on dole organized party in city of riches

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the artist comes after the rearranged dole
organized means the letters of dole are put into a different order

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, the usual crossword artist
a do is an informal word for a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A painter on benefits throws a party in a wealthy city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organized' gives ELDO; 'on' in an across clue means placed after. Dole is British slang for unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary golden city sought by Spanish conquistadors in South America was imagined to overflow with riches.

clue.text: This will carry goalkeeper across line

indicators.note: across means the keeper word stretches over the line letter, which sits inside it

parts.note: a goalkeeper is a saver of shots

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper dives across the line to make a carrying save.
explanation.definitionFit: A tray, typically silver, is used by a butler or waiter to carry drinks or letters.

clue.text: Throwing in a couple of days at home before golf

indicators.note: before puts the earlier pieces ahead of the golf letter

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for day, so two of them give DD
someone at home is in
Golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Throwing in a couple of days off at home before a round of golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Throwing in extra means including or adding it as a bonus, as in throwing in a free gift.

clue.text: Urgent broadcast of item about TV and press

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the other piece
broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of item are scattered

parts.note: television and newspapers together are the media

explanation.surface: An urgent news item broadcast across TV and the press.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast of' rearranges four letters to IMTE, which is split in two so the press word sits between IM and TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter needing action at once, without any delay, is urgent.

clue.text: Soldier at sea must welcome a time to soak

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so the soldier word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a marine is a soldier serving aboard ship

explanation.surface: A soldier at sea must greet a period of getting soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat or fish is steeped in a seasoned liquid before cooking, which is exactly soaking it.

clue.text: The sort of plan that might afford a respite?

definitions.text: The sort of plan that might afford a respite?

parts.words: The sort of plan that might afford a respite?
parts.note: relief means respite, and a plan can be a chart of terrain, so a respite plan is a chart showing hills and valleys

explanation.surface: A scheme that might give someone a break.
explanation.walkthrough: Plan is read as a drawing of land, and respite as another word for the raised-ground sense of the same term.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of chart shows hills and valleys by shading or modelling, and its first word also means a respite.

clue.text: Fancies strikers covering Maradona at the back

indicators.note: covering means the strikers word wraps round the picked letter

parts.note: chimers are things that strike the hours, like clock bells

indicators.note: at the back picks the final letter of Maradona

explanation.surface: Fancy strikers marking Maradona from behind on a football pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strikers' and 'Maradona' suggest football; the strikers are actually bells or clocks that strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Wild imaginings and fantasies are fancies, named after the fire-breathing monster of Greek myth.

clue.text: Rougher-sounding area in bay perhaps north of reef

indicators.note: in means the area letter goes inside the horse word

parts.note: a bay is a reddish-brown horse, one example

indicators.note: in a down clue, north of means the topmost part of the word reef, which also sits below the horse piece

explanation.surface: An area in a bay lies north of a reef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bay' looks like a coastal feature with a reef, but it is a horse; 'north of reef' gives its top letter, R.
explanation.definitionFit: A voice that is husky and grating is rougher-sounding, the comparative of the adjective.

clue.text: Highly original if missing from the last-but-one round

indicators.note: missing from means the little word if is taken out of the round

parts.note: the round before the final in a knockout tournament is the semi-final

explanation.surface: Something brilliantly original, if absent from the penultimate round.
explanation.definitionFit: Work that is influential and groundbreaking, strongly shaping what follows, is called seminal.

clue.text: Large Ford touring America's capital

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the large and car letters surround the country

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes
the Ka is a small Ford car model
America is the USA; the possessive just links it to capital

explanation.surface: A big Ford car on a tour of the USA's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the capital of Zambia, in southern Africa.

clue.text: Cooks here know about desire

indicators.note: about means the know word goes round the other piece

parts.note: ken is a Scottish word meaning to know
an itch is a restless craving or desire

explanation.surface: Chefs know all about craving.
explanation.definitionFit: The room where cooks prepare meals is the place they work, so it is where cooks are.

clue.text: Fighting the German keeper

parts.note: fighting between nations is war
der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: A German goalkeeper in a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A prison guard is a keeper of the inmates, a dated British title for a jailer.

clue.text: Conservative may be fair, changing sides initially

indicators.note: changing sides at the start means the opening letter, standing for one side, is swapped for the opposite side

parts.note: fair hair or skin is light in colour

explanation.surface: A Tory may be fair-minded, switching political sides at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing sides initially' swaps the first letter L (left) for R (right).
explanation.definitionFit: In politics the conservative wing is called the right, after French assembly seating.

clue.text: Burrowing creatures? Reportedly only tigers perhaps

indicators.note: reportedly means the phrase is heard rather than read, so its sound matters

parts.note: mere means only, as in a mere child; tigers are one example of big cats

explanation.surface: Something burrowing, rumoured to be nothing more than tigers.
explanation.definitionFit: These African mongooses live in colonies and dig extensive burrows, hence burrowing creatures.

clue.text: Risk it — especially boxing these birds

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the phrase holds the answer inside it

explanation.surface: A gambler urged to take a chance, especially by boxing these birds.
explanation.definitionFit: The red kite is a bird of prey, and the plural names a group of such raptors.

clue.text: Stormy exchange and stormy night calms nag

indicators.note: a stormy night throws things into turmoil, so these letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: A row on a wild night soothes a nagging horse.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'stormy' is the anagram indicator; the first belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bitter quarrel full of mutual insults is a heated, stormy exchange of words.

clue.text: Asian and old international swamped by money from letting property

indicators.note: swamped by means the international letter is engulfed inside the money word

parts.note: rental is the income a landlord gets from letting

explanation.surface: An Asian, and an old international, flooded with rental income.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things of the East, so it serves as a synonym for Asian.

clue.text: Stink about second one putting on an act

indicators.note: about means the smell word goes round the other letters

parts.note: pong is British slang for a bad smell
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A smelly performer pretending for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone striking a pose is pretending or adopting an affectation, i.e. putting on an act.
